purpose: MC-01 census: classify every libs/common type against platform/shared primitives. Media-specific wrappers and Media-owned SPIs are kept; duplicate engine, provider, cache or observability implementations are marked for reuse, not silently retained.

MEDIA_OWNED.meaning: Media-specific contract or SPI with no platform-owned equivalent; kept as Media source

PLATFORM_WRAPPER.meaning: Media-scoped adapter over a platform/shared primitive; kept, must not re-grow the platform feature

REUSE_REVIEW.meaning: Duplicates a canonical capability; callers migrate to the canonical module — marked, not deleted in-place
types: observability.MediaProcessingMetrics: zero-dependency ad-hoc metrics collector duplicating the role of audio-video-observability MediaWorkflowMetrics (Micrometer) and platform observability; no new production sink should be built on it

DUPLICATE_CACHE.meaning: reimplements cache; canonical path is modules/infrastructure/cache over DistributedCachePort

guards.noPlatformInternals: libs/common must not import com.ghatana.platform internals beyond the published dependency boundary
guards.noSecondMetricsSink: audio-video-observability MediaWorkflowMetrics is the canonical metrics surface; MediaProcessingMetrics is REUSE_REVIEW and must not gain new production sinks
guards.noDuplicateEngine: any new DUPLICATE_* entry is a build failure, not a silent addition
